product.name: Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that offers Arabic language learning through interactive flashcards, stories, songs, videos, games, and crafts.

product.name: YouTube Channel
product.description: A channel providing access to educational cartoons in Arabic, featuring music-based episodes for children.

product.name: Book Collection
product.description: A collection of books featuring stories from the adventures of Adam and Mishmish, aimed at teaching Arabic to children.

product.name: Live Shows
